meta.title: Morrri
meta.description: Online booking for hair and nail salons.

hero.title: Online booking your salon and your stylists will both love.
hero.subtitle: Give every designer their own schedule and services, keep client contact details private, and manage it all from one place.
hero.imageAlt: A stylist cutting a client's hair in a small salon with terracotta walls

about.title: What {product} is
about.body: {product} is appointment booking software for hair and nail salons in the United States. A salon signs up, adds its stylists, services and opening hours, and gets a booking page of its own at <url>morrri.com/your-salon</url> to share with clients. Clients book on that page (no account needed) and the salon manages the day from one calendar.
about.notASalon: We sell software to salons. We are not a salon, and we do not take a cut of a booking.

page.title: A page per salon
page.body: Your stylists, your services, your prices and your hours, at an address you can print on a card.
page.imageAlt: A nail technician filing a client's nails at a white table

calendar.title: One calendar
calendar.body: Every chair on one screen, with double bookings caught before they happen and walk-ins added by hand.

clients.title: Clients you keep
clients.body: Visit history, notes and tags stay with the salon, and clients message you without either side swapping phone numbers.

reminders.title: Appointment reminders
reminders.body: Every booking gets a confirmation by email straight away, and a reminder before the appointment. A client who gives a mobile number while booking can also tick a box to get that reminder as a text message: appointment reminders only, never marketing, and never without asking. The whole program, including the exact wording of the opt-in, is set out at <link>morrri.com/sms</link>.
